cs.t: I almost lost faith in my abilities through the ordeal. I love building, picking every single component, I love having the latest hardware. This particular build was setup to be primarily a Hyper-V host, for the VM drive I chose an Intel 750 PCIe SSD. The drive is amazing, super fast, makes traditional SSDs look like spinning disk. Choose the EVO to save a few bucks for the customer, as the server OS wasn't going to doing any heavy lifting. I never imagined that a hard drive could be incompatible with an OS.
cs.th: What is a coder's worst nightmare? (2014)
